component.name: Hyprtune
component.summary: Settings for Hyprland, Waybar, awww and fuzzel

description.p: Tune your Hyprland desktop with live preview: gaps, borders, blur, tiling layouts, input, the Waybar bar, awww wallpapers and the fuzzel launcher. Works with both the new Lua config and the legacy hyprlang config, and keeps your own files' comments intact.
